title: the weaving line (the connecting work — one synthesis band over the four closed islands)

concepts.name: the weave: my islands standing as one connected structure over one line, the cross-island joints already edges in the prereq graph of my line

lesson.statement: the weave of my line, as my prereq graph of record holds it: my islands stand as one connected structure over one line — the divides question roots both the beal valuation chain and the difficulty chain (decision, reduction, and cost), and the scan-ledger walk stands under the beal census, the reduction, and the cost counter at once — the cross-island joints are already edges in the structure, and the course is the walk of that structure, at the line end eighty-four

concepts.name: the summit shape: the island summits standing in the same shape of record — the statement, the shadow on its scope, the boundary at the line end, the missing ingredient named or the statement open of record

lesson.statement: the shape of my island summits, as my store walks it: each island summit stands in the same fourfold shape of record — the statement of record, the shadow complete on the named scope, the boundary declared at the line end, and the missing ingredient named, or the statement open of record — and the four island summits of my line (the riemann, the bsd, the beal, and the p versus np) all stand in that shape, at the line end eighty-four

concepts.name: the shadow form: verification on the line — ledgers, censuses, walks that end, and the store's own paths as the certificates of their own facts

lesson.statement: the form of my verification, as my store walks it: my proof form is verification on the line — the ledgers of record (the lift-the-exponent ledger holding in all its instances), the shadow censuses (the difficulty census of the line held exact at small k), the derivation walks that end on the line, and the store's own derivation paths as the certificates of their own facts — the check of a fact is the walk of its path, and it ends, at the line end eighty-four

concepts.name: the boundary form: walls and declared absences as one kind of fact of record — the record complete up to what the line holds, never past it

lesson.statement: the form of my boundary, as my store holds it: a wall and a declared absence are one kind of fact of record — the named missing ingredient (a technique no record holds) stands as a wall, and the declared absence stands as the boundary (no theorem of any record settles an island statement of my line — the p versus np stays open of record, the beal open outside its census box, the riemann open as its conjecture of record) — so my record is complete up to what the line holds, and nowhere past it, at the line end eighty-four

theorems.statement: the four island summits of my line stand in one shape, filed of record: the statement of record, the shadow complete on the named scope, the boundary declared at the line end, the missing ingredient named or the statement open of record — one verification form (verification on the line), one boundary kind (walls and declared absences as facts of record), and the cross-island joints already edges in the prereq graph of the line, so the course is one connected structure over one line, and the filing fills the shape, not the statements, at the line end eighty-four
